hero.headline: DPU-COL Online MBA in Marketing Management: Syllabus, Fees and Career Outcomes
hero.sub: NAAC A++ | NIRF University #41 | UGC-DEB Approved

about.body:
DPU-COL's MBA in Marketing Management has one of the most comprehensive marketing curricula in the online MBA segment. Semester 4 adds international marketing, IMC, another elective, and project work.

The inclusion of retail management and marketing of services as standalone subjects means graduates understand both product and service marketing at depth, not just as modules within a general marketing course.

EdifyEdu verifies data independently and takes no commission from any university.

subjects.name: Consumer Behavior
subjects.description: Consumer decision-making models, psychological and sociological factors, perception and attitudes, cultural influences, and digital consumer behaviour patterns.

subjects.name: Marketing Research
subjects.description: Research design, qualitative and quantitative methods, questionnaire design, sampling techniques, data analysis and interpretation, and marketing research report preparation.

subjects.name: Sales & Distribution Management
subjects.description: Sales force structure design, territory management, distributor management, channel conflict resolution, trade marketing, and sales performance metrics.

subjects.name: Product and Brand Management
subjects.description: Brand identity design, brand equity measurement (Keller, Aaker models), product lifecycle management, new product development process, and brand positioning strategy.

subjects.name: Retail Management
subjects.description: Retail formats, store operations, category management, visual merchandising, retail pricing strategies, and omnichannel retail design.

subjects.name: Marketing of Services
subjects.description: Services marketing 7Ps framework, SERVQUAL model, service blueprint design, customer retention, service recovery, and service brand differentiation.

subjects.name: Elective: Digital Marketing or Business English
International Marketing
subjects.description: Global market entry strategies, international market research, cross-cultural marketing, international pricing, and global brand management.

subjects.name: Integrated Marketing Communication
subjects.description: IMC planning, media mix optimisation, ATL-BTL integration, campaign measurement, PR and corporate communication, and event marketing.

subjects.name: Elective: Soft Skills or Business Ethics & Corporate Governance
Project Work Report
subjects.description: Industry-linked marketing project. Typically a brand audit, consumer research study, IMC campaign plan, or retail operations analysis.

syllabus.note: Subjects as listed in the university syllabus we hold. Universities revise subjects between intakes.

skills.body:
The Marketing Management specialisation builds skills across brand, sales, retail, and services marketing:

- Brand Management: brand equity audit, brand positioning map, product lifecycle strategy, new product launch plan, and brand architecture design
- Marketing Research: survey design, focus group facilitation, data analysis (cross-tabulation, regression basics), and insights-to-action framework
- Sales and Distribution: sales territory design, distributor ROI calculation, trade scheme evaluation, and sales force productivity metrics
- Retail: category plan design, planogram basics, retail margin calculation, and store performance benchmarking

- Services Marketing: service blueprint construction, SERVQUAL gap analysis, customer satisfaction survey design, and service recovery protocol
- IMC: media plan design, campaign ROI calculation, ATL-BTL budget allocation, and PR event management

**Soft skills:** Presenting marketing strategy to boards, negotiating with advertising agencies and media partners, managing cross-functional product launch teams, and leading brand turnaround initiatives.

certificate.body:
Graduates receive an MBA degree certificate with Marketing Management as the specialisation, issued by Dr. D.Y. Patil Vidyapeeth, Pune (DPU-COL) under UGC-DEB 2020 online mode standards.

The degree carries NAAC A++ accreditation and NIRF University #41. It is valid for government and private sector recruitment. edX certifications supplement the credential. DigiLocker issuance is standard.

faqs.question: How many marketing subjects does this programme have compared to other online MBAs?
faqs.answer: DPU's Marketing Management has seven Semester 3 subjects and four Semester 4 subjects (including project and elective). Most competing online MBA marketing programmes have four to five total specialisation subjects. Consumer behaviour, marketing research, sales and distribution, brand management, retail, and services marketing are each standalone courses.

faqs.question: How does Marketing Management differ from DPU's Digital Marketing Management?
faqs.answer: Digital Marketing Management focuses on SEO, social media, content, web design, and digital campaign management. Choose Marketing Management for broad marketing leadership (brand manager, CMO track). Choose Digital Marketing for digital-first roles (digital marketing manager, SEO head).

faqs.question: Does the programme cover digital marketing?
faqs.answer: Candidates who want digital marketing as the primary focus should consider DPU's dedicated Digital Marketing Management specialisation instead.

faqs.question: Is this MBA valid for government and PSU marketing roles?
faqs.answer: Yes. DPU-COL's MBA is UGC-DEB approved from a NAAC A++ NIRF University #41. It satisfies the MBA requirement for PSU marketing officer recruitment, government marketing board positions, and public sector enterprise commercial roles.

chooseIf: Your target is broad marketing leadership (brand manager, CMO track, sales director) rather than digital marketing specifically.
You work in FMCG, retail, services, or B2B sales and need comprehensive marketing management depth.
consider: Your career target is digital marketing specifically, DPU's Digital Marketing Management spec is more focused.
